notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) covering 2026-10-20/21, ~75 queries total. All four lanes independently reported this as a genuinely quiet day: no same-day AI, security, or devtools/cloud announcement cleared the sourcing bar, and most forward-looking leads duplicated what's already correctly on file (NVIDIA GTC Berlin already carries its Oct 20-22 range and Oct 21 keynote detail from NVIDIA's own domain; Azure Automation's Python 2.7/3.8/PowerShell 7.1/7.2 retirement is already filed from Microsoft's own RSS feed at Sept 30, 2026, one day earlier than a secondary mirror's Oct 1 restatement found this run; a routine GitLab 19.5 point release was left out as too low-value, consistent with prior runs' judgment on routine minor releases). Two items survived verification: Apple's MacBook Pro/iMac refresh event upgraded from rumored to confirmed now that Apple itself sent press invites naming it 'Pro and Tell' for Oct 28, 2026 in Los Angeles; and Cloudflare's acquisition of the Deno team, corroborated independently across multiple reputable outlets (The New Stack, BetaNews) with consistent details even though no primary deno.com/cloudflare.com post surfaced in search, implying Deno Deploy shuts down roughly six months out — filed at month precision and 'expected' confidence for April 2027.
concerns: data/events/2027-02.json still carries multiple near-duplicate Let's Encrypt 64-day-certificate entries (one explicitly self-flagged 'Superseded') from the src/lib/id.ts title-overlap dedupe gap flagged in prior runs — not re-triggered this run; still needs a maintainer merge/prune.

Google's own Play policies documentation gives conflicting dates for the same location-permission policy change across locales (2027-01-27 in the English page vs 2026-10-28 in a Hungarian-locale copy found this run), layered on top of the already-flagged Play Console Contacts/Location duplicate cluster in data/events/2027-01.json — left unfiled to avoid compounding both issues; needs reconciling together.

Search results for 2026-dated AI news are heavily polluted by templated SEO/aggregator sites making contradictory, unsourceable claims (fabricated Gemini 4 / GPT-6 variant launches, Anthropic IPO rumors) — the ai lane found nothing clearing the sourcing bar today as a result; worth tightening routine/sources.md to require an org-domain citation even more strictly for this lane.

src/lib/id.ts's slugify() truncates a title to 60 chars before tokenizing, so the existing long title 'Apple expected to launch refreshed M6 MacBook Pro and M6 iMacs' has its trailing 'iMacs' token silently cut to 'ima'. Any corrected title that still says 'iMacs' no longer shares enough tokens to pass isSameThing's 0.6 overlap floor, so this run had to drop 'iMacs' and the 'Pro and Tell' name from the title (kept in the summary instead) purely to make the correction merge rather than duplicate. A maintainer should tokenize before truncating, or truncate per-token, in slugify().
